title: Player Availability Rating (PAR) - A Tool for Quantifying Skater Performance for NHL General Managers
file_name: Player Availability Rating (PAR) - A Tool for Quantifying Skater Performance for NHL General Managers.pdf
universal_lens: PAR integrates physical, statistical, and predictive features into a unified regression framework for skater performance quantification. A statistical framework integrating physical player traits and usage patterns to assess cumulative NHL skater performance without advanced metrics.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs Bayesian inference to update PAR posterior distributions using real-time player data, enabling dynamic risk-adjusted rankings. Bayesian belief updates on player availability using conformal predictive distributions derived from historical physical and usage data.
gse_mapping: GSE applies conformal prediction to PAR outputs, generating probabilistic availability windows and state-transition models for tactical planning. Situational reasoning engine models player state transitions via discrete Markov chains informed by PAR-derived performance kernels.
